title: HVAC Filter Life and Replacement
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hvacfilter:life
| stats latest(runtime_hours) as hours, latest(rated_hours) as rated by unit
| eval life_pct=round(100*(1-hours/rated),1), replace=if(life_pct<10,1,0)
| sort life_pct
description: Tracks HVAC filter life by runtime hours and reminds you to change filters before airflow and efficiency suffer.
value: A clogged filter wastes energy and strains the system; a runtime-based reminder beats guessing or forgetting.
implementation: Ingest system runtime into `index=personal`; alert when a filter is near end of life.
visualization: Gauge of remaining filter life per unit.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how used your air filters are and reminds you to change them before they clog up.
